generate.title: Generate onboarding tour
generate.body: DevDigest indexes the repo and specs, then writes a 5-section guided tour: overview, architecture, key modules, getting started, and conventions & gotchas.

addRepo.title: Add a repository
addRepo.intro: Paste a GitHub repository URL — DevDigest clones it locally and imports open PRs. API keys aren’t needed here; set them once in <settings>Settings → API Keys</settings>.
addRepo.footer: API keys live in Settings · <kbd>esc</kbd> to close
